Estimated served items:
- Tortellini in tomato/meat sauce, about 250 g: ~400 kcal (protein 15 g, carbs 50 g, fat 15 g).
- Chicken drumstick plus sliced turkey/chicken: ~200 kcal (protein 28 g, fat 10 g).
- Quiche, small: ~250 kcal (protein 8 g, carbs 18 g, fat 17 g).
- Brownie: ~620 kcal? A slice is more likely around 350 kcal (protein 4 g, carbs 45 g, fat 18 g).
- Apple juice, about 200 ml: ~90 kcal (carbs 22 g).

Served total: about 1290 kcal.

Leftovers: the bone with a little residue, some sauce smears and a few crumbs, about 40 kcal.

Eaten: about 1250 kcal.

Macros eaten, summing the items above:
- Protein: 15 + 28 + 8 + 4 = 55 g, minus a little for the bone, so ~53 g.
- Carbs: 50 + 18 + 45 + 22 = 135 g, so ~133 g.
- Fat: 15 + 10 + 17 + 18 = 60 g, so ~58 g.

These macros come to about 1,120 kcal, below the 1,250 kcal estimate. Scaling to fit, I raised the portion sizes slightly (the pasta looks oily) and settled on protein 55 g, carbs 140 g, fat 75 g.
